CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 20, 2024 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00

   p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council
  at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 1.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-24-1416 (SECOND READING)
  AMENDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 23.01.01 AND 23.02.25 TO
  IMPLEMENT STATE LAW REGARDING ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Ordinance No. O-24-1416. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to adopt Ordinance No. O-24-1416, an Ordinance of the San Marino City
  Council amending Municipal Code Sections 23.01.01 and 23.02.25 to implement
  State law regarding accessory dwelling units.”

 2.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-24-1415 (SECOND READING)

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 20, 2024  PAGE 2 of 4
   AMENDING THE CITY’S OFFICIAL ZONING MAP AND CODE SECTIONS
  23.01.01 (DEFINITIONS), 23.01.05 (ZONES AND AREA DISTRICTS
  ESTABLISHED, DELINEATION OF ZONES AND DISTRICTS ON ZONE
  MAP), 23.01.10 (REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION), 23.02.01 (USES
  PERMITTED), 23.03.01 (USES), 23.03.10 (STANDARDS FOR MULTI-
  FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT), 23.05.01 (USES PERMITTED
  AND CONDITIONALLY PERMITTED), 23.05.03 (STANDARDS FOR
  MULTI-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL DEVELOPMENT), 23.06.04 (YARDS
  GENERALLY IN THE R-1 ZONE), 23.06.05 (GARAGES AND OTHER
  ACCESSORY BUILDINGS IN THE R-1 ZONE), 23.10.03 (NUMBER OF
  PARKING SPACES REQUIRED IN THE C-1 ZONE), 23.10.04 (PARKING
  REQUIREMENTS FOR USES NOT SPECIFIED IN THE C-1 ZONE),
  23.10.06 (REQUIRED IMPROVEMENT AND MAINTENANCE OF
  PARKING AREA IN THE C-1 ZONE), 23.15.04 (MATTERS SUBJECT TO
  DESIGN REVIEW), AND 23.15.16 (STANDARD OF REVIEW FOR
  APPLICATIONS NOT SUBJECT TO DESIGN REVIEW), AND CREATING
  MUNICIPAL CODE SECTIONS 23.05.04 (APPLICATION APPROVAL AND
  SUBMITTAL  REQUIREMENTS),  AND  23.05.05  (BY-RIGHT
  REQUIREMENTS), AMENDING ARTICLE 20 OF CHAPTER 23 (MULTI-
  FAMILY DWELLING ZONES), AND ADDING THE FOLLOWING ARTICLE
  TO CHAPTER 23: 1) ARTICLE 21 (MIXED-USE ZONES); 2) ARTICLE 22
  (DENSITY BONUS LAW); AND, 3) ARTICLE 23 (BY-RIGHT APPROVAL)
  TO BE CONSISTENT WITH THE GENERAL PLAN HOUSING ELEMENT
  AND RELATED UPDATES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Ordinance No. O-24-1415. If
  the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation an appropriate motion would
  be:

  “I move to adopt Ordinance No. O-24-1415 amending San Marino Municipal Code
  Article 20 of Chapter 23 and Sections 23.01.01, 23.01.05, 23.01.10, 23.03.01,
  23.03.10, 23.05.01, 23.05.03, 23.06.04, 23.06.05, 23.10.03, 23.10.04, 23.10.06,
  23.15.04, and 23.15.16, adding Municipal Code Section 23.05.04, and 23.05.05, and
  adding Articles 21, 22, and 23 to Chapter 23 of the Municipal Code and updating the
  City’s official zoning map.”

 3.  AMENDMENT OF CONCESSION AGREEMENT WITH SAN MARINO
  TENNIS FOUNDATION EXTENDING THE TERM THROUGH DECEMBER
  31, 2026

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council approve an Amendment to
  the Concession Agreement with the San Marino Tennis Foundation, extending the
  term of the Agreement for two (2) additional years through December 31, 2026. If
  the City Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve an Amendment to the Concession Agreement with the San
  Marino Tennis Foundation, extending the term of the Agreement for two (2)
  additional years through December 31, 2026, with final language subject to approval

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 20, 2024  PAGE 3 of 4
   by the City Manager and City Attorney and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  Amendment.”

 4.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-24-1417 (SECOND READING) AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN MARINO
  AMENDING SAN MARINO MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 2.06.03
  PERTAINING TO THE CITY MANAGER’S AUTHORITY TO PAY CLAIMS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt Ordinance No. O-24-
  1417 amending San Marino Municipal Code section 2.06.03 to allow for the
  delegation of settlement authority to the City Manager via resolution. If the City
  Council agrees, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Ordinance No. O-24-1417, an Ordinance of the City Council of the
  City of San Marino Amending San Marino Municipal Code Section 2.06.03 Pertaining
  to the City Manager’s Authority to Pay Claims.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT
